# braidworks references

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Print source citations for installed weavers. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/index.md).

```text
usage: braidworks references [-h] [--format {human,json}] [--only WEAVERS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {human,json}
  --only WEAVERS
```
